page_title: Inklane — Image annotation and handwritten PDF notebooks for Windows
description: Draw on screenshots and write in printable PDF notebooks. Inklane keeps a longer note attached to the exact spot you marked, all on your Windows PC.
headline: Keep the note
hero_text: Draw on a screenshot or write in a PDF notebook. Pin the longer explanation to a point, then fold it away while you work.
notebook_alt: Inklane showing an ink drawing of a courtyard in a squared notebook, with a searchable index of four anchored notes.
workspace_heading: From a quick mark to a closer look.
image_alt: A floor plan open in Inklane’s dark image workspace, with handwritten marks and an expanded note attached to the courtyard threshold.
image_zoom: Open the full-size image workspace screenshot
image_caption: Image workspace · A detail under review
image_heading: Mark up a folder of images.
image_body: Open a PNG or JPEG and browse the images alongside it. Circle a detail with a pen or mouse, type a label and save. The editable marks live beside the original. Export an annotated PNG to share.
note_body: A numbered point opens into a note card. Write as much as the detail needs, then collapse it. Search the notes index to return to that spot, even on another notebook page.
paper_body: Choose A4 or A5 in either orientation. Use blank, ruled or squared pages and set spacing and margins in millimetres. Add pages as you write.
paper_export: Share the PDF with a reader or print it at its physical size. Reopen an Inklane notebook to keep editing the ink, text and notes.
paper_alt: New notebook dialog with A5 portrait paper, a 5 mm square grid and a 15 mm margin in the live paper preview.
paper_zoom: Open the full-size paper settings screenshot
paper_caption: Paper setup · A5 with a 5 mm grid
install_text: Run Setup, choose Install and open Inklane from Start. The desktop runtime is included and the app installs for your Windows account.
unsigned: This installer is unsigned. Windows may show “Unknown publisher”. SHA-256 checksums and a portable ZIP are available with the release.
signing_unknown: See the release notes for publisher information and download verification.
